episode_title: How AI Helped His family and Reconnect With His Daughters - Jason Decker Ep. 376

real_qa.q: How did Jason Decker use Silly Girl's Kitchen to reconnect with his daughters?
real_qa.r: Jason Decker and his daughters purchased Silly Girl's Kitchen, a food blog, as a family project centered on their shared passion for cooking shows. By creating videos together about making recipes, he was able to spend intentional time with his daughters aged 18 and 15, transforming work into a vehicle for deepening relationships. He stated that even without making any money from the company, being able to have heartfelt conversations and truly get to know his daughters through this shared activity has been the greatest gift of his life.
real_qa.requete: Silly Girl's Kitchen Jason Decker family reconnect

real_qa.q: What was Jason Decker's relationship with his oldest daughter before and after addressing family issues?
real_qa.r: Jason Decker's relationship with his oldest daughter Maddie was a solid zero out of five when she was a freshman in high school. The turning point came when he asked her directly, 'What about me isn't working for you?' She responded that she was tired of him just saying sorry without changing his behavior. After both of them did personal work on healing and changing patterns, his relationship with his oldest daughter improved to a five out of five, requiring both of them to do the work individually and together.
real_qa.requete: Jason Decker daughter relationship zero to five

real_qa.q: Why did Jason Decker leave the automotive industry after 26 years?
real_qa.r: Jason Decker left the automotive industry after working 14 to 16 hour days, taking only three days off a month, and surviving on caffeine pills. He realized his family situation was deteriorating: his father had a stroke and increasing medical appointments, and his daughters needed his presence. After praying for guidance, he met someone at a birthday party who recommended looking into cash-flowing businesses he could easily run. He viewed this meeting as God's final directive to leave the car business and pursue an opportunity to work with his kids.
real_qa.requete: Jason Decker left automotive industry why

real_qa.q: How much time did Jason Decker spend with his family while working in automotive?
real_qa.r: While working in the automotive industry, Jason Decker spent approximately three to four hours per day with his family on average. However, he was physically present but mentally absent—constantly thinking about work, checking his phone, and worrying about work-related matters rather than being genuinely present and engaged with his children.

real_qa.q: What question did Jason Decker ask his daughter that changed their relationship?
real_qa.r: Jason Decker asked his oldest daughter Maddie, 'What about me isn't working for you?' This single question became the beginning of a new relationship between them. When she answered honestly that she was tired of him just saying sorry without changing his behavior, it hit him 'like a freight train' and created the shift within him to stop repeating the same patterns.

guest.bio_context: Jason Decker spent 26 years in the automotive industry, including 24 years at the same dealership before transitioning to co-own Silly Girl's Kitchen, a food blog and YouTube channel. He made this career pivot after experiencing significant life changes, including his father's stroke, his oldest daughter preparing for college, and a strained relationship with his daughters that prompted him to reassess his priorities and become more intentional with family time.
